chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 25, short black hair with a fade, light beard, wearing a bright orange zip-up track jacket with white stripes and black joggers
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman about 28, long wavy black hair loose, wearing a teal silk house robe with a thin gold belt, gold bangles
chars.BROTHER: a Moroccan man about 32, neat short hair, trimmed full beard, wearing a navy blue work polo shirt with a company logo patch and a grey lanyard badge

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Inside a Moroccan apartment in Tangier, upstairs hallway. NARRATOR hurries out of a bedroom door toward the viewer, phone pressed to his ear, wide panicked eyes; behind him in the bedroom doorway WIFE leans on the door frame, laughing and twirling her hair playfully, face clearly visible. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, warm evening light, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. NARRATOR stands at the top of a tiled Moroccan staircase, one hand on his forehead, phone at his ear, embarrassed nervous face, sweating a little, looking back over his shoulder. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Close-up of NARRATOR sitting on the stairs, staring at his phone screen, biting his lip, thinking hard what to say, a closed bedroom door blurred above him in the background. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical split screen phone call: top half BROTHER at an office desk in Tangier holding a phone to his ear, eyebrows raised, listening seriously; bottom half NARRATOR in a dim apartment stairwell talking fast into his phone, gesturing with his free hand, worried. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical split screen phone call: top half BROTHER calm and still, a strange quiet half smile, thinking, not angry at all; bottom half NARRATOR bracing himself, eyes squeezed half shut, expecting his brother to explode. No text.
